## About
A and J Garage is a full service auto repair shop run by Robby Raley and his son Austin. Robby has loved cars since he was a kid, and Austin grew up working on cars right beside him.
From routine maintenance to major engine overhaul, foreign or domestic, we've got you covered. We'll tell you what's going on with your car before any work starts, and Robby won't let a car leave the shop that isn't running right or isn't safe.
Customers rate us 4.7 from 25 reviews on Google. At A and J Garage, we treat you like family.

## Services
- Air Conditioning: It's hot out there. We'll keep your car cool.
- Brake Service: We inspect your complete disk or drum brake system, including master cylinder, power booster, pads or shoes, drums or rotors, and hoses and lines, then recommend replacing any worn parts.
- Diagnostic Services: Check engine light scan and diagnostics. We pull the codes, interpret them, and check injectors, coil packs and sensors with our diagnostic equipment.
- General Repairs: Full service repairs for import and domestic vehicles.
- Routine maintenance to major engine overhaul: Whether it's regular upkeep or a major engine job, foreign or domestic, we've got you covered.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get a quote before bringing my car in?
A: Yes. Give us a call for a free quote.

Q: Are you open on Saturdays?
A: Yes, we offer Saturday appointments. Saturday hours are 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM.

Q: Do you work on diesel engines?
A: Yes. We work on both gas and diesel engines, and Robby trained in diesel mechanics.

Q: Do you fix imports as well as domestic cars?
A: We do full service repairs on both import and domestic vehicles.
